Market note

Selling an online business in Poland

A fast-growing market with a strong domestic marketplace and an operating cost base below western Europe.

Channels

The domestic marketplace holds a leading position in many categories, and a seller account with a long positive history is a substantial part of the value of smaller businesses.

Structures

Share transactions for incorporated businesses; asset deals where an operation is being absorbed into an existing company.

Buyers

Domestic operators expanding within categories, and western European buyers looking for operations with a lower cost base and access to the wider region.

Practical

Where a business serves several central European countries from one operation, the split of revenue per country is one of the first things a buyer asks for.

Listings

Businesses currently offered across Europe are published at the European marketplace (https://www.businessforsale.eu/online-business-for-sale).
